Defence Minister reviews Territorial Army in J&K

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh reviewed the Territorial Army's role in Jammu and Kashmir. He emphasized its importance for national security and defence preparedness. The Territorial Army is reportedly strengthening security and national outreach in the region. Singh's visit aimed to assess the force's capabilities and its contribution to India's defence strategy.
